rationale: Create Intermodal Tank Transport as the canonical U.S.-based global ISO-tank logistics and depot-services platform. Correct the census's dead 2024 acquisition source and record Apollo Infrastructure Funds' 2023 structured equity investment as closed and active, while leaving the exact stake, broader closing date and current fund or legal vehicle as not publicly disclosed. Apollo's 2025 portfolio supplement and current Infrastructure partner board biography support continuing ownership, and no Apollo exit was identified through August 8, 2026. Treat the 2025 Bulk Tainer Group acquisition as a platform bolt-on rather than a separate Apollo portfolio company.

afterImage.description: Intermodal Tank Transport (ITT) is a Houston-headquartered, U.S.-based global provider of ISO-tank container transportation, logistics and depot services for bulk-liquid chemical and food-grade supply chains. Founded in Medellin in 1993, ITT arranges end-to-end transport across major modes, operates a tank fleet and provides maintenance, cleaning and inspection through a global office and depot network. Apollo Infrastructure Funds announced a structured equity investment in June 2023; later Apollo filings and portfolio materials support closed-active ownership, but the exact stake, broader legal closing date and specific current fund or vehicle are not publicly disclosed. ITT acquired Bulk Tainer Group in August 2025, and no Apollo exit was identified through August 8, 2026.
